Bettina, Corinne cited two sets of doors in your 15 Oct 2025 post in this channel:
- **Door 6**, yesterday afternoon.
- **Doors 3–4**, that morning.

You asked for the two examples to be kept separate in the incident notes. The aim was to tell a real carrier no-show apart from an appointment that was moved but still showed on the printed shift sheet.
